answer: commit-reveal scheme for answer submission is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the garden here is verification, the wander of cost is what stops the farm, and the karst of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
